title: Online Learning for Minimizing Maximum Tardiness in Single-Machine Scheduling
abstract: arXiv:2611.27067v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study online learning for minimizing maximum tardiness (\OMMT) in single-machine scheduling. In each round, the learner selects a permutation of \(n\) fixed jobs, representing a schedule. The environment then reveals a processing time and a due date for each job, and the learner incurs a vector-valued loss whose components correspond to the tardiness of the individual jobs. The goal of the learner is to minimize \(\alpha\)-regret, the difference between the learner's maximum cumulative tardiness and \(\alpha\) times that of the best fixed permutation in hindsight, for as small \(\alpha\) as possible. We investigate OMMT under both stochastic and adversarial environments. translated_title: 单机调度中最小化最大延误的在线学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究单机调度中最小化最大延误（OMMT）的在线学习问题。在每一轮中，学习器选择n个固定作业的一个排列，代表一个调度方案。随后环境揭示每个作业的加工时间和交货期，学习器承受一个向量值损失，其各分量对应于各个作业的延误。学习器的目标是最小化α-遗憾，即学习器的最大累计延误与事后最优固定排列最大累计延误的α倍之间的差异，且α越小越好。我们在随机环境和对抗环境下研究OMMT。在随机设置中，我们证明了跟随领先者（FTL）算法的期望1-遗憾为O(n log n / Δ²)，并给出了相应的高概率界，其中Δ是依赖于分布的间隔参数。
tldr: 该论文开创性地研究了单机调度中最小化最大延误的在线学习问题，并证明了在随机环境下FTL算法的期望1-遗憾为O(n log n / Δ²)，同时给出相应的高概率界。
en_tdlr: This paper initiates the study of online learning for minimizing maximum tardiness in single-machine scheduling, proving that the Follow-the-Leader algorithm achieves O(n log n / Δ²) expected 1-regret with a corresponding high-probability bound in the stochastic setting.
